english.title: HGV used / kept on road when levy not paid
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were liable for the levy in respect of a heavy goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which had been

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[kept]_

on a road to which the HGV Road User Levy Act 2013 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on a day in respect of which the HGV road user levy charged in respect of the vehicle had not been paid
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(1)(b) and (2) of the HGV Road User Levy Act 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location

english.notes:
(i) 'Heavy goods vehicle' is defined in section (2)(1) of the Act.
(ii) This Act applies to all public roads in the United Kingdom, subject to any order made by the Secretary of State under section 3(2) of the Act.
(iii) In the case of a UK heavy goods vehicle each person in whose name the vehicle is registered under the 1994 Act is liable for any HGV road user levy in respect of the vehicle, as well as any other person by whom the vehicle is kept.
(iv) In the case of a non-UK heavy goods vehicle each person who is the holder of a Community licence in respect of the vehicle is liable for any HGV road user levy in respect of it, as well as any person by whom the vehicle is kept.
(v) Where two or more persons are liable for levy in respect of the same vehicle at the same time, their liability is joint and several

IMPORTANT NOTE: Where the alleged offender is directly 'using' or 'keeping' the vehicle for which the HGV road user levy has not been paid, the offence under section 11(1)(a) should be used (PNLD document H11424).
